name: Zork
author: Infocom / Microsoft; MojoZork by Ryan C. Gordon
description: Zork I, II and III, the 1980 text adventures, in the Terminal. Type zork, or zork 2 to jump to Zork II. SAVE and RESTORE keep one game per title.

descriptions.en: Zork I, II and III, the 1980 text adventures, in the Terminal. Type zork, or zork 2 to jump to Zork II. SAVE and RESTORE keep one game per title.
descriptions.it: Zork I, II e III, le avventure testuali del 1980 (in inglese), nel Terminale. Scrivi zork, oppure zork 2 per Zork II. SAVE e RESTORE salvano una partita per titolo.
